title: 第4章 鸡飞狗跳
content_zh:
从大杂院出来，刘济民不由得打了一个冷战。风虽然小了，但温度一点没升。刘济民将头顶的LF帽往下压了压，确保骑自行车时，帽子不会飞了出去。

    菊儿胡同在南锣鼓巷后面，出了南锣鼓巷，往南走就是王府井了。

    此时大家都在院里休息，胡同的巷子里空无一人，刘济民无聊的拨动着铃铛，叮叮当当的声音响了一路。

    还没到王府井，周围的人就多了起来，组成了灰、蓝、绿、黄四色为主，其余色彩为辅的人流。

    自行车的链条和铃铛声密密麻麻，简直像是街头交响乐。这年头可选的衣服色彩比较少，款式也单调，有条件选其它颜色的家庭比较少。

    当然还有一层原因，是整个社会都喜欢稳重的穿着，将鲜艳的穿着视作不正经。

    你大腿还没露出来，骚呼呼的闲话就满天飞了。

    除了密密麻麻的人群，最先映入眼帘的是高耸的百货大楼。百货大楼总共六层，楼顶插着数面迎风招展的红旗，楼顶中间的位置悬挂着巨大的红五角星。

    王府井百货大楼总共六层，九个大门，1955年开业，被誉为新中国第一店。开业第一天九个大门全部打开，数千人同时涌入百货大楼，当天总客流量达到了16.4万人。

    有的人是穿着鞋进来，光着脚出去。

    晚上关门后，工作人员打扫完百货大楼，惊得瞠目结舌。

    嘿！您猜怎么着？顾客被踩掉的鞋，足足装了几大簸箕。

    刘济民并没有进百货大楼，而是去了隔壁的东风市场。

    东风市场，在燕京人嘴里叫东安市场。东安市场历史悠久，可以追溯到1903年。1903年前，东安门大街两侧每天都有上百小贩摆摊，因为容易妨碍王公大臣出入宫城，被步兵统领衙门的人安置在了王府井。

    原本是神机营的旧操场，八国联军入京后，神机营被裁撤了，刚好用来安置小贩。没想到，这里人越来越多，最终发展成了东安市场。

    1966年，燕京城破four旧，那些带有浓厚旧时代气息的街道或地点名称纷纷被更改，东安市场改名东风市场，取“东风压倒西风”之意。

    百货大楼里面卖日用百货和电器，想要买肉得到东风市场。

    东风市场外立面前悬挂着各种各样的口号，相比之前，还是少了许多。

    刘济民推着自行车走进东风市场，熙熙攘攘的人群挤来挤去。刘济民一边往副食品区走，一边小心翼翼，避免自行车碰到人。
content_en:
Coming out of the courtyard, Liu Jimin couldn't help but shudder. Although the wind has dropped, the temperature has not risen at all. Liu Jimin pushed down the LF hat on his head to ensure that the hat would not fly out while riding a bicycle.

    Ju'er Hutong is behind Nanluogu Lane. After leaving Nanluogu Lane, walking south is Wangfujing.

    At this time, everyone was resting in the courtyard, and the alleys in the alley were empty. Liu Jimin rang the bell in boredom, and the tinkling sound rang all the way.

    Before reaching Wangfujing, there were more people around, forming a flow of people mainly in four colors: grey, blue, green and yellow, supplemented by other colors.

    The sound of bicycle chains and bells is dense, almost like a street symphony. These days, there are relatively few colors and monotonous styles of clothes to choose from, and there are relatively few families who can afford to choose other colors.

    Of course, another reason is that the entire society likes to dress modestly and regards bright clothes as immodest.

    Even before your thighs are exposed, flirtatious gossip is flying all over the place.

    Apart from the dense crowds, the first thing that catches the eye is the towering department store. The department store has a total of six floors. There are several red flags fluttering in the wind on the roof, and a huge red five-pointed star hangs in the middle of the roof.

    Wangfujing Department Store has a total of six floors and nine doors. It opened in 1955 and is known as the first store in New China. On the first day of opening, all nine doors were opened, and thousands of people poured into the department store at the same time. The total passenger flow that day reached 164,000.

    Some people come in wearing shoes and go out barefoot.

    After closing for the night, the staff were astonished after cleaning the department store.

    Hey! Guess what? The customer's shoes that were trampled off were enough to hold several large dustpans.

    Liu Jimin did not enter the department store, but went to the Dongfeng Market next door.

    Dongfeng Market is called Dong'an Market among Yanjing people. Dongan Market has a long history, dating back to 1903. Before 1903, there were hundreds of vendors setting up stalls on both sides of Dong'anmen Street every day. Because it easily hindered the access of princes and ministers to the palace, the people who commanded the Yamen of the infantry placed them in Wangfujing.

    It was originally the old playground of the Shenji Camp. After the Eight-Power Allied Forces entered Beijing, the Shenji Camp was dismantled and used to house vendors. Unexpectedly, there were more and more people here, and it eventually developed into Dong'an Market.

    In 1966, the city of Yanjing was dilapidated, and the names of streets or places with a strong flavor of the old era were changed one after another. Dong'an Market was renamed Dongfeng Market, which means "East wind prevails over West wind".

    The department store sells daily necessities and electrical appliances. If you want to buy meat, you can go to Dongfeng Market.

    There are various slogans hanging in front of the facade of Dongfeng Market, but there are still many fewer slogans than before.

    Liu Jimin pushed his bicycle into Dongfeng Market, and the bustling crowd crowded around. As Liu Jimin walked toward the non-staple food area, he was careful not to hit anyone with his bicycle.
